children: Home Federal Bancorp of Louisiana reported net income of $1.911 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared with $1.599 million a year earlier. Net interest income rose to $5.904 million, while diluted earnings per share were $0.62, up from $0.52. The company also reported a 3.83% net interest margin, compared with 3.63% in the prior-year quarter.
Net interest income increased 12.2% to $5.904 million from $5.261 million in the same quarter of 2025.
Net income was $1.911 million, versus $1.599 million a year earlier.
Basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.64 and $0.62, respectively, compared with $0.53 and $0.52.
Total interest income was $8.697 million; total interest expense was $2.793 million.
Non-interest income increased to $853,000 from $650,000, while non-interest expense rose to $4.081 million from $3.851 million. The provision for credit losses was $275,000, compared with $43,000.
The company completed a bulk sale of 44 rental properties during the quarter.
Non-performing assets totaled $1.556 million at September 30, 2026, down from $3.649 million at June 30, 2026.
The number of one-to-four-family residential loans identified as non-performing declined to seven from 16 over the quarter.
Home Federal Bank operates ten full-service banking offices and a home office in northwest Louisiana.
